## ⚠️ Notice ⚠️ 

Parsing of the `content-type` header has been improved to a strict parser in PR #6414. This means only header values in the form described in [RFC 9110](https://httpwg.org/specs/rfc9110.html#field.content-type) are accepted.

## What's Changed
* chore: npm ignore AI related files by @climba03003 in https://github.com/fastify/fastify/pull/6447
